authored_by: Claude (build owner), written and committed before any run on it; references by hand-written SQL restricted to the cohort, or by reading the documents
rule: Each item is typed about a selected patient group. Correct only when the answer equals the reference computed inside that group; a decline item is correct only when the tiered core returns no answer.

A.sql: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM concept_patient WHERE kind='condition' AND concept='heart_failure'

B.description: patients with a statin fill in 2029
B.sql: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM fill WHERE drug_class='statin' AND substr(fill_date,1,4)='2029'

C.description: patients with an inpatient stay admitted in 2029
C.sql: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM stay WHERE type='inpatient' AND substr(admit_date,1,4)='2029'

items.say: how many of them had an ED visit in 2029?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM utilization_event WHERE kind='ed_visit' AND substr(event_date,1,4)='2029' AND patient_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM concept_patient WHERE kind='condition' AND concept='heart_failure')

items.say: How many ED visits did these patients have in 2029?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM utilization_event WHERE kind='ed_visit' AND substr(event_date,1,4)='2029' AND patient_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM concept_patient WHERE kind='condition' AND concept='heart_failure')

items.say: what are the 5 most common conditions among them?
items.reference_sql: SELECT concept, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM concept_patient WHERE kind='condition' AND patient_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM concept_patient WHERE kind='condition' AND concept='heart_failure') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

items.say: show their appointments scheduled in 2029 by final status
items.reference_sql: SELECT final_status, COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE substr(scheduled_date,1,4)='2029' AND patient_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM concept_patient WHERE kind='condition' AND concept='heart_failure') GROUP BY 1

items.say: how many of them have diabetes?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM concept_patient WHERE kind='condition' AND concept='diabetes' AND patient_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM fill WHERE drug_class='statin' AND substr(fill_date,1,4)='2029')

items.say: break them down by coverage type
items.reference_sql: SELECT coverage_type, COUNT(*) FROM patient WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM fill WHERE drug_class='statin' AND substr(fill_date,1,4)='2029') GROUP BY 1

items.say: how many metformin fills did they have in 2028?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fill WHERE drug_class='metformin' AND substr(fill_date,1,4)='2028' AND patient_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM fill WHERE drug_class='statin' AND substr(fill_date,1,4)='2029')
items.reference_sql_before: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM fill WHERE drug_class='metformin' AND substr(fill_date,1,4)='2028' AND patient_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM fill WHERE drug_class='statin' AND substr(fill_date,1,4)='2029')
items.changes: 2026-11-16: the question asks only how many fills; the patient count (107) was dropped from the reference after a run answered 691 fills without it and was marked wrong. Fill count unchanged.

items.say: what was the 30-day readmission rate for these patients in 2029?
items.reference_sql: (each stay once) recipes.RECIPES['readmission_rate']['sql'] with the year as :year
items.reference_sql_before: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(readmitted_30d), ROUND(1.0*SUM(readmitted_30d)/COUNT(*),4) FROM stay WHERE type='inpatient' AND discharge_known=1 AND substr(discharge_date,1,4)='2029' AND patient_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM stay WHERE type='inpatient' AND substr(admit_date,1,4)='2029')

items.say: how many recorded deaths occurred among them in 2029?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM death WHERE substr(death_date,1,4)='2029' AND patient_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM stay WHERE type='inpatient' AND substr(admit_date,1,4)='2029')

items.say: how many members did each payer have in 2029-06, for those patients only?
items.reference_sql: SELECT payer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM member_month WHERE month='2029-06' AND patient_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM stay WHERE type='inpatient' AND substr(admit_date,1,4)='2029') GROUP BY 1

items.say: How many of their scanned radiology reports dated in 2029-06 report an infiltrate?

changes.change: The 30-day readmission rate reference now counts each hospital stay once (repeated, overlapping and continuing stay rows are one stay) and a readmission as an inpatient stay beginning 1 to 30 days after discharge. The earlier reference summed the stay table's readmitted_30d flag, which counts a stay recorded twice as a readmission after zero days.
